snippet.title: Hyper Trigger - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4975530/Hyper_Trigger/

Welcome to the digital world of HyperNet, agent. Your services as cutting-edge security software have been requested after a number of hazardous viruses have been detected. Time is of the essence as you must dispatch threats and identify the root cause of the issue before a system-wide shutdown takes effect.

Lucky you're fast.

Music: Tropical Gateway by soundofwills

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hitstopgames/
Discord: https://discord.gg/F8kC9gSCx
